title: Controllership Intern
salary_raw:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the teams

Stripe’s Controllership organization is responsible for the accurate and timely recording of Stripe’s business activities, the integrity of our financial reporting, and the scalable processes and controls that support our growth. We partner across Finance, Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Legal, Tax, Treasury, and Internal Audit to understand Stripe’s products and operations, resolve complex financial issues, and maintain a strong control environment.

We are hiring four Controllership Interns, with one role on each of the following teams: Accounts Receivable (AR), Controls, Product Accounting, and Corporate Accounting. In any placement, you’ll work with experienced teammates and cross-functional partners on meaningful accounting, data, systems, controls, or process-improvement work.

  • Accounts Receivable (AR) supports invoicing, collections, cash application, and related financial operations through scalable, accurate, and auditable processes.
  • Controls supports Stripe’s internal-control environment by documenting and assessing processes, identifying risks, supporting control testing, and helping teams design sustainable improvements.
  • Product Accounting supports Stripe’s products by understanding their financial-data flows, evaluating accounting implications, and developing scalable processes
  • Corporate Accounting supports Stripe’s close, financial reporting, corporate accounting processes, and control environment

What you’ll do

We’re looking for graduate students who want to deliver outsized impact while accelerating their growth in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You’ll apply classroom learning to important accounting and financial-data problems at an industry leader in fintech.

You’ll support meaningful work with an impact on Stripe and its users, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders. Depending on your placement, you may:

  • Support core Controllership activities based on your placement, including accounts receivable operations, monthly and quarterly close, financial reporting, product accounting, or internal controls
  • Prepare or support journal entries, account reconciliations, supporting schedules, variance analysis, and other accounting deliverables
  • Analyze large financial and operational datasets using Google Sheets, SQL, AI tools, or other systems to identify unusual activity, data-quality issues, reconciliation breaks, control gaps, or operational trends
  • Support invoicing, collections, cash application, or related order-to-cash processes, where relevant to your placement
  • Research accounting questions and prepare clear supporting documentation under the guidance of experienced accountants
  • Assist with the design, documentation, testing, and improvement of accounting processes and internal controls
  • Support financial reporting, management analysis, and internal or external audit requests
  • Partner with stakeholders across Accounting, Finance, Product, Operations, Engineering, Sales, Legal, Tax, Treasury, and Internal Audit to understand business activities and resolve issues
  • Drive continuous process improvement, standardization, simplification, automation, and reporting enhancements

title: Intern CCO Enablement & Programs
salary_raw:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

As our Celonis Customer Organization Enablement & Programs Intern, you will sit at the intersection of talent development, operational excellence, and customer success. The Celonis Customer Organization (CCO) unites high-impact teams such as Value Engineering, Celonis Services, Academy, and Customer Programs. CCO Enablement serves as the foundational backbone across these groups, supporting their end-to-end learning journeys—from seamless onboarding to advanced skill building. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to plan, execute, and monitor projects that standardize best practices and scale our organization’s collective expertise.

The Role:

In this role, you will serve as a central operational anchor for enablement and programs designed to scale the capabilities of our customer-facing teams. You will facilitate clear communication between different CCO departments, maintain centralized resource hubs, help structure project documentation and status reports. By synthesizing post-training evaluations and monitoring key performance indicators, you will provide actionable insights that help refine training curriculum, improve project delivery workflows, and support the ongoing growth of our global organization. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with teams and key stakeholders from across GTM and Celonis, giving you a whole perspective of how Celonis brings value to our customers as well as internally.

The work you’ll do:

  • Create & Maintain Communications & Assets: you’ll get to own and design content, process and structure for ensuring proper management of materials and communications channels.
  • Coordinate and organize workshops, enablements and training programs: you’ll have the opportunity to work with teams across GTM/Celonis to coordinate global and regional sessions, content preparation, communications, and post-session success reporting for onboarding & upskilling live sessions. 
  • Support Stakeholder Management: partner with CCO Enablement team members and subject matter experts for requirements gathering and feedback on enablement program effectiveness & prioritization.
  • Program Analysis & Reporting: analyze program compliance and produce reports for leadership review; understand business needs to assess effectiveness
  • Support the execution of strategic learning programs: work alongside senior members of the team to help them drive effective program design, management and deliver a best-in-class enablement experience.

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era:

  • You will learn to work with AI agents and tools as one of your primary tools, focusing on creating new automations, ways of working and frameworks.
  • You will develop foundational specification and context skills to help translate business needs into precise AI instructions.

Based purely on merit and academic excellence, graduating high school students will be invited to interview, and select applicants will receive a Meritocracy Fellowship. Those that excel will obtain offers to join Palantir full time.

Skip the debt. Get the real education. Earn the Palantir degree.
